in_hebrew.name: אמברוגינו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אמברוגינו הוא שילוב של השם היווני 'אמברוז' שפירושו אלמוות, ו'גינו' שפירושו יין או גפן. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'ambrosia', שפירושו מאכלם של האלים, ומוסיף לו המשמעות 'קטן' או 'נולד'. השם משלב את הרעיון של אלמוות עם יין או גפן, ויכול להתפרש כ'אלמוות נולד' או 'עוז של אלוהים'.

in_greek.name: Αμβρογίνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αμβρογίνο προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα 'Αμβρόζιος', που σημαίνει 'αθάνατος' και συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'ambrosia', που σημαίνει 'το φαγητό των θεών'. Η προσθήκη του επιθήματος '-ίνο' σημαίνει 'γεννήθηκε από' ή 'καταγωγή από'. Έτσι, το όνομα Αμβρογίνο μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'γεννήθηκε από τον αμβρό' ή 'αθάνατος γεννημένος'.

in_latin.name: Ambrogino
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ambrogino derivatur ex nomine graeco 'Ambrosios', quod significat 'immortalis'. Additio suffixi '-ino' habet significationem 'genitus' vel 'ortus'. Nomen Ambrogino potest interpretari ut 'immortalis genitus' vel 'Deus meus'. In traditione christiana, nomen Ambrogino associatur cum sancto Ambrosio, episcopo Mediolani, qui fuit defensor fidei christianae.

in_english.name: Ambrogino
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ambrogino originates from the Greek name 'Ambrosios', meaning 'immortal'. The suffix '-ino' adds a diminutive or genitive sense, implying 'born of' or 'descendant of'. In Christian tradition, Ambrogino is associated with Saint Ambrose, a 4th-century bishop of Milan known for his strong advocacy of Christian faith. The name symbolizes spiritual immortality and divine heritage, reflecting the values of eternal life and devotion to God.

saint_reference.note: Bishop of Milan, defender of Christian faith

data.cultural_impact: The name Ambrogino has its roots in the ancient Roman civilization, reflecting a rich cultural history. Although there are several saints bearing this name throughout Christian history, it has become particularly associated with St. Ambrose of Milan (340-397 AD), who was a prominent bishop, teacher, and father of the Church, renowned for his eloquence, piety, and humility. He played a critical role in re-establishing orthodoxy in Western Christianity, and his influence continues to be felt up to this day.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ambrogino has deep spiritual significance derived from the early Christian saint, St. Ambrose, whose life teaches us several valuable lessons. His example embodies the importance of faith and obedience, dignity and righteousness, intellectual brilliance and dedication, and true leadership. The name acts as a reminder of the divine gift of immortality and the strength to follow the path of righteousness towards eternal life. Throughout history, it has inspired countless individuals to uphold the virtues and ideals associated with the name.
